Element.attribute:
Test data supplies the test conditions executed in test scripts with concrete values. Without test data, test cases cannot be implemented and test scripts cannot be executed. Test data provides the input into a test condition to evaluate whether the result aligns with the solution requirements.

Some data may be used in a confirmatory way, typically to verify that a given set of input to a given function produces some expected result. Other data may be used in order to challenge the ability of the solution to respond to unusual, extreme, exceptional or unexpected input.
To verify that a given set of inputs to a given function produces some expected result.
